article.title: Why I started a record label (and other people should, too)
article.author: Aja Arnold
article.content: While DIY music culture has typically been credited as being pioneered by the white- and male-dominated punk and later hardcore scenes of the 1970s and 1980s, independent (or DIY) labels have been historic markers in the fight for creative and financial independence for artists of all genres—particularly Black artists—since as early as the 1920s. Read more via Scalawag : Why I started a record label (and other people should, too) .
